bio.short: Software engineer (First Class Honours, USYD) who builds products end to end, and the relationships around them. I engineer BackupMeraki at Nexivity, shipped a production app as its sole engineer, and have taught machine learning to 530+ engineering students.
bio.full:
I'm a software engineer who builds things end to end, and I do my best work when the people I'm building for are in the room.

Right now I'm the engineer on BackupMeraki at Nexivity: a SaaS on AWS that backs up, restores and compares Cisco Meraki network configurations, effectively version control and disaster recovery for cloud-managed networks. I work directly with the founder, taking each piece of work from a design doc to shipped code across eight repositories.

Before that I was the sole engineer at Done Life, an AI-first life-admin app. One month in, I made the call to scrap a year of no-code tooling and built a working prototype in a single day that outperformed it. From there I took the app from a scaffold to production on iOS and Android, with an AI email pipeline, per-user encryption, subscription billing, Terraform infrastructure and CI/CD.

The other half of my story is people. I've taught machine learning to 530+ engineering students at the University of Sydney, most of whom arrived having never written code, and I learn every student's name. As President of the USYD Robotics Club I grew it from 230 members to 1,800, the second-largest club on campus, with one motto: "we have to be better, not bigger."

coreThemes.title: Measure, Then Decide
coreThemes.description: I'd rather measure than guess: an offline eval harness before shipping AI changes at Done Life, and a measured baseline before fixing Cisco rate limits at Nexivity. I direct AI coding agents with the same discipline: design first, review everything.

coreThemes.title: People First
coreThemes.description: I've taught ML to 530+ engineers, most of whom had never coded, and grew USYD Robotics Club from 230 to 1,800 members. I translate technical trade-offs for founders, clients and students alike.
